items.title: The henselization of a pair depends only on the radical of the ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the henselization constructed from a pair depends only on the radical of the ideal: two ideals with the same vanishing locus give the same ring. The statement carries a slogan recording this dependence. The proof compares the two constructed rings: each is henselian with respect to the other's ideal because the ideals have the same radical, and the universal property of the construction produces ring maps between them in both directions, which are mutually inverse by uniqueness in that universal property.
